Question Choices: In a signed-number model, remove 4 groups of tokens, each group worth −6 points. Fill in the blanks: The change is −4 × ___, so the total score change is ___ points.
Solution: Removing 4 groups of value −6 changes the score by −(4 × (−6)) = (−4) × (−6) = +24. The blanks are −6, 24.

Question Choices: A motion model has a constant vertical rate of −4 meters per minute, with upward positive. Trace the motion backward 5 minutes (a time change of −5 minutes). How much higher was the earlier position? Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Use signed change = signed rate × signed time change. Tracing backward gives a negative time change.
Solution: The time change is −5 minutes. Vertical change = (−4) × (−5) = 20 meters. The earlier position is 20 meters higher; this traces recorded motion backward.
